blocking.finding: The couple score cannot be out of 12 if both partners guess all 12 questions. feature_1: 'Each partner answers every question twice: once for themselves, once guessing the other. The app counts every guess that lands on the partner's own answer and scores it out of 12.' tab_content_1: 'Each partner answered 12 questions about the other, and a guess that matched the partner's own answer scored 1 point. The final board put Leah and Sam Brandt first at 11 of 12 and June and Ravi Chandran last at 6 of 12.' That is 24 one-point guesses per couple, yet the board (image: '11 of 12 guesses matched', 9/8/6 of 12), howto_step_2 ('one number out of 12') and feature_4 ('couples who scored under 8') all score couples out of 12.
blocking.fix: Make each question carry one guess per couple: partners take turns, one answers for themselves and the other guesses (6 guesses each, 12 per couple). Rewrite feature_1 ('Partners take turns on each question: one answers, the other guesses. The app counts every match and scores the couple out of 12.') and tab_content_1 ('Each couple played 12 questions, partners taking turns to guess, and a matched guess scored 1 point.'). Image, step 2, feature_4 and FAQ 7 then stand unchanged. CMS item update + verify-live.
